narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in New Jersey on July 16. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: Heavy rain caused a landslide across US Route 46 in Knowlton Township, closing the highway in both directions.
Flood waters rushing over Warren County Route 519 in White Township severely damaged the roadway.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Harmony Township, with many roads becoming impassable.
Segments of US Route 1 in Edison Township became impassable due to flooding.
Jersey Avenue in North Brunswick Township was closed due to flooding between Huron Road and Corporate Road.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters on Woodbridge Street in New Brunswick.
